QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_45

question.text: The SIA Report should include (per Section 5.14) a statement that:

answer.text: The SIA complies with the independence and other ethical requirements of the Code of Conduct applicable to SIAs issued by the SRO / SEBI
The SIA has received a royalty fee from the SE
The SIA waives all liability for errors
The SIA has recommended the SE's ZCZP bond to retail investors

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.137 (Section 5.14, item 16) requires a statement that the social impact assessor complies with the independence and other ethical requirements of the Code of Conduct applicable to SIAs issued by the SRO/SEBI. Option A is a direct restatement of that requirement. The Trap: B, C, and D are not items in the Section 5.14 list on p.137. They are distractors and should not be read as prohibitions established by that section - they simply are not what the SIA Report is required to state under item 16. Note: The answer follows directly from item 16 of the Section 5.14 checklist on p.137.
